en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a large villa-like building labeled as a restaurant and bakery with timber-frame elements and a verandah, set behind a wooden picket fence. To the left is a long, lower outbuilding with a chimney. Several men in early 20th‑century clothing stand near the entrance gate. Leafless trees and a wooded hillside rise behind the buildings. Printed red text at the bottom identifies the scene and the publisher.
